beats.text: Want a second date? Ask one more question.
Researchers analysed over two thousand speed-dating conversations.
People who asked more questions got more second dates.
Especially follow-up questions. The ones that show you were listening.
The estimate: one extra question per date, across twenty dates, meant one more yes.
So less pitching yourself. More: wait, tell me more about that.

sources: Huang, Yeomans, Brooks, Minson & Gino (2017). It doesn't hurt to ask: Question-asking increases liking. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 113(3). Speed-dating data (110 participants, >2,000 conversations): more questions -> more second dates; one more question per date across 20 dates ~ one more 'yes'; follow-up questions most common and effective. Via HBS Working Knowledge.
